page.overview:
Who is Shioyaki?

Shioyaki is a fish-man who was a member of the Arlong Pirates and the head of banquets.

Shioyaki is a salmon fish-man. He has pink skin, and a fin on the top of his head along with wavy brown hair. He has a black wave tattoo on his forehead. He wears a dark green shirt with a red flower design on it, a blue wrap around his lower body, tan pants, and brown sandals. He also has hair on his forearms.

Shioyaki does not think much of the Marines compared to his high opinion of his crewmates.

Being a fish-man, he has incredible mobility underwater as well as the ability to stay submerged for as long as he desires. Like all of his race, he is also much stronger than an average human. Despite these advantages, he is weak in comparison to strong adversaries such as the Straw Hat Pirates, especially when he was swept aside easily when Luffy swung Momoo around.
